summary.text: Jill Carter is a Republican state senator who has represented Missouri Senate District 32 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has worked as a family farm operator.

paragraphs.text: Jill Carter lives in Granby, Missouri, graduated from East Newton High School and earned a degree from Crowder College.
In the 2023-2024 session, Carter was vice chair of the Health and Pensions Committee, and in 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Joint Committee on Public Assistance.
